Forwarding a job ad.

As part of Indiana University Bloomington's Faculty 100 initiative, the Department of Mathematics in the College of Arts and Sciences invites applications for an open-rank position (Assistant, Associate, or Full Professor) to begin in Fall 2027. These are 10-month appointments, ideally beginning August 1, 2027.

We seek an outstanding mathematician whose research engages substantially with artificial intelligence, data science, or scientific machine learning. The successful candidate will have a primary appointment in Mathematics and opportunities to collaborate broadly with faculty in the Luddy School of Informatics, Computing, and Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, the Institute for Scientific Computing and Applied Mathematics, and scientific units across our campus.

We are particularly interested in researchers working in mathematical artificial intelligence, broadly construed. This includes, but is not limited to: machine learning algorithms, formal proof assistants, and large language models.

Details: https://math.indiana.edu/about/math_ai_position_ad_final1.pdf

Let me pass on a clarification I got: "10-month appointment" refers to the fact that the university pays 10 full salaries per year; the position itself is permanent (assistant, associate, or full professor depending on experience).
